messages:
mike: heads up — deploybot failed to publish image for release/2026.1 to eu-ecr with a provenance ledger conflict. staging canary is stuck in the queue :warning:

julia: ugh, logs?

mike: pasted the push error: `409 Conflict: provenance ledger mismatch: expected attestation timestamp 2026-03-21T10:23:11Z, got 2026-03-21T10:22:09Z`

deploybot: automated: publish aborted for image sha256:abcd1234. Retrying will be blocked until ledger reconciliation completes. See https://go/release/provenance for remediation steps.

sre-bot: FYI — we've seen this happen when regional mirror attestation lags. Canary push to eu-ecr likely raced with mirror replicator.

emma: can we retag to the previous digest and promote? that would unblock deploys for the change window.

julia: if we retag we lose the new build metadata. Is this a non-functional change? we should confirm QA signoff.

ben: quick check: `aws ecr batch-get-image --repository-name prod/app --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:abcd1234` returns 200 for us, but cosign verifies fails: `cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/cosign` -> timestamp mismatch.

mike: proposal: (1) hold this push, mark release as "publish-hold" in release board, (2) pin service to prior digest for canary traffic, (3) coordinate with infra ops to force ledger reconciliation for the eu mirror, (4) if reconciliation not done within 30m, manual retag+annotate with `x-release-note` and proceed.

carla: I prefer a conservative flow — open a release hold and notify product. @julia @emma please confirm QA can sign off on the previous digest for canary. I'll add a release-note entry documenting the hold and reason.

jeff: (background) infra ops is oncall. @ben can you run `replicator status --region eu` and post results?

ben: replicator shows backlog: 42 items, last successful attestation job 00:12:45 ago. KMS rotate yesterday might have caused a small window. Paging infra oncall now.

mike: action: carla opens hold, ben and infra oncall to reconcile ledger. if not fixed by +30m we will retag with a `manual-publish` prefix and set `x-provenance-note: manual-retag-due-to-ledger-lag`. everyone agree? :thumbsup:

julia: :thumbsup: I'll check QA for prior digest acceptance and ping product.

carla: I'll update the release board and slack channel with status every 10m. thanks all."
